topic.title: Ancient Woodland / Ancient Trees / Veteran Trees / Irreplaceable Habitat
topic.source_contract: exact habitat identity, inventory and field evidence, ancient or veteran status, direct and indirect impact zones, root protection and hydrology, avoidance, wholly exceptional reasons, compensation strategy, consultation, permission, implementation and long-term monitoring evidence

sources.publisher: Defra, Forestry Commission and Natural England

scope_guards: An inventory polygon is not field confirmation of exact habitat condition.
A veteran-tree indicator is not proof of legal status or impact.
A buffer proposal is not evidence that deterioration is avoided.
A compensation strategy is not a substitute for avoidance.
Wholly exceptional reasons are not inferred from project importance.
Planning permission is not a felling licence.
Completed planting is not replacement of irreplaceable habitat.
No score or promotion is written without exact habitat, impact, decision, implementation and monitoring evidence.
